🆕 New post (Published: July 30, 2026)

Hanno City is accepting donations for relief from the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake. A donation box has been set up at the information desk counter on the 1st floor of Hanno City Hall.

All donations collected will be sent through the Japanese Red Cross to the disaster relief distribution committees established by affected prefectures. One hundred percent of donations will be forwarded to affected residents to support their immediate living needs.

We appreciate your cooperation.

Donation collection

A donation box is set up at the information desk counter on the 1st floor of Hanno City Hall. If you need a receipt, the Community Welfare Division (Counter 11) on the 1st floor of City Hall can provide one.

Note: If you prefer to donate directly to the Japanese Red Cross, please visit the Japanese Red Cross website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/14121.html
summary: ℹ️ Accepting donations for 2026 Kumamoto earthquake disaster relief
